response.sql: WITH tallies AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), '') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), '')), shares AS (SELECT hand, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM tallies), compared AS (SELECT hand, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(hand, 'Unknown') AS hand, tally, share, share - average_share AS exceeds_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY share DESC, hand;
